title: volutaria leucantha
intro: Volutaria leucantha, commonly known as White Volute, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Volutaria leucantha include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
